note: Hand-maintained. Every candidate ever tested for this system, including the dead ones. Kept visible so a known-dead idea cannot quietly come back as a fresh insight.
principle: Expectancy, drawdown and out-of-sample come before win rate. A number with no sample size beside it is not evidence.

candidates.name: Gold Setup A/B (LIVE)
candidates.decision: Trading, but the edge is NOT established over the long run
candidates.detail: Re-validated 2026-07-28 on the tick archive. Full-period 95% CI is -0.011R..+0.164R, which INCLUDES ZERO; 17/31 quarters positive. The often-quoted +0.168R/50.2%/PF1.42 came from ~662 days (2024 onward) and does not generalise: 2020 -0.166R, 2022 -0.098R. Setup A (+0.298R) looks robust on only 58 trades in 7.5 years; Setup B is 91% of all trades and returns -0.010R across the five unseen years.

candidates.name: Tighter stop x0.6 + TP1 1.5R
candidates.decision: Withdrawn - was on demo forward test (magic 990714)
candidates.detail: Scored +0.285R vs +0.177R on the short sample and was promoted to a demo forward test on that basis. Over 7.5 years it is +0.071R against a +0.075R baseline. The gain was specific to the window; neighbouring settings (x0.6/2.0R, x0.8/1.5R, x1.0/1.5R) are all within noise.

candidates.name: BTC H4 Donchian-20 trend
candidates.detail: 35% win rate and fat-tailed - 64% of profit came from 5 trades. Losing streaks are normal and expected, not evidence of failure.

candidates.name: GKO signal follower
candidates.decision: Forward test only; needs a locked holdout
candidates.detail: Integrity checks passed and the edge looks real but slippage-fragile. Not validated. Next step is a tick-level re-simulation to settle break-even management before anything is changed.

candidates.name: Pack S1 - London sweep to auction acceptance
candidates.detail: The specified stop (sweep extreme + 0.10x M15 ATR) is a median 3.6 points on gold: 41% of trades take a full stop and only 28% ever reach +1R. Its unfiltered baseline is also negative, so the filters are not the problem - the premise is.

candidates.name: Pack S5 - VWAP pullback after displacement
candidates.decision: Fails - sample far below the required minimum
candidates.detail: First run returned +1.015R with an 82% win rate. All of it was a lookahead bug: the code read the M15 bar CONTAINING the current M5 bar and entered before that bar closed. Correcting it moved expectancy by -1.07R.

candidates.name: Pack S2 / S3 / S4
candidates.decision: Cannot be tested with data that exists here
candidates.detail: S2 needs GC signed futures delta (the pack itself says it is untestable without one). S3 needs a CME 6E volume profile. S4 needs a macro-surprise history plus US 2-year yields at M1. Untested is not the same as disproven.

candidates.name: Reversal / early-exit detection
candidates.decision: Do not revive without new information
candidates.detail: Breakeven-after-1R, ATR trailing, structure-break exit and armed-structure exit were all tested. Every one LOWERED expectancy. You cannot separate a reversal from a deep pullback in real time: 30% of winners first draw to -0.5R. A tighter INITIAL stop helps; a reactive trailing stop hurts.

candidates.name: Trade Quality Model (A+/A scoring)
candidates.detail: An attempt to score setups 0-100 and trade only the best. No pre-trade feature separated winners from losers. This is why the dashboard shows which conditions are met rather than a confidence score.
